payouts_state_coherent.name: payouts_state_coherent
payouts_state_coherent.value: ((status = 'PENDING'::payout_status) AND (disbursed_at IS NULL)) OR ((status = 'PAID'::payout_status) AND (disbursed_at IS NOT NULL))

public.vw_lobby_search.name: vw_lobby_search
public.vw_lobby_search.definition: SELECT l.id, l.slot_id, l.host_id, l.title, l.min_reliability, l.quota, l.price_total, l.price_per_person, l.join_deadline, l.status, s.start_at, s.end_at, c.sport_type, c.name AS court_name, v.id AS venue_id, v.name AS venue_name, v.city, ( SELECT count(*) AS count FROM lobby_members m WHERE m.lobby_id = l.id AND (m.status = ANY (ARRAY['HOLDING'::member_status, 'CONFIRMED'::member_status]))) AS joined FROM lobbies l JOIN court_slots s ON s.id = l.slot_id JOIN courts c ON c.id = s.court_id JOIN venues v ON v.id = c.venue_id

public.vw_venue_monthly_revenue.name: vw_venue_monthly_revenue
public.vw_venue_monthly_revenue.definition: SELECT v.id AS venue_id, v.name AS venue_name, date_trunc('month'::text, b.booked_at) AS bulan, count(*) AS total_booking, sum(b.gross_amount) AS omzet, sum(b.platform_fee) AS fee_sebar, sum(b.venue_payout) AS payout_gor FROM bookings b JOIN lobbies l ON l.id = b.lobby_id JOIN court_slots s ON s.id = b.slot_id JOIN courts c ON c.id = s.court_id JOIN venues v ON v.id = c.venue_id WHERE b.status <> 'CANCELLED'::booking_status GROUP BY v.id, v.name, (date_trunc('month'::text, b.booked_at))
